children: LibertyStream Infrastructure Partners Inc. (TSXV: LIB | OTCQB: VLTLF | FSE: I2D) (“
LibertyStream
” or the “
Company
”) announces the appointment of Keirah Burrell, previously Vice President of Accounting Operations, as Interim Chief Financial Officer, succeeding Morgan Tiernan, who is retiring from the role.
The transition comes as LibertyStream continues to develop its financial reporting, internal controls and systems in support of its previously announced plans for a listing on a U.S. exchange.

Mr. Tiernan has played a pivotal role in LibertyStream’s development as a public company, providing financial leadership through its formative years and subsequent growth. His longstanding service and financial stewardship have helped establish the foundation on which the Company continues to build.

“Morgan has contributed to LibertyStream throughout its public-company journey, and we are grateful for his years of service and dedication,” said Alex Wylie, President & CEO. “On behalf of the Board and the entire team, I thank him for his contributions and continued support through this handover and wish him every happiness in retirement.”

Ms. Burrell is a licensed Certified Public Accountant with more than 15 years of experience in public accounting, controllership and finance transformation. At The Siegfried Group, she led accounting stabilization, M&A transitions and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) programs for public companies. Her background also includes roles at PricewaterhouseCoopers, Poly and HP Inc.

Since joining LibertyStream earlier in 2026, Ms. Burrell has played a leading role in strengthening the Company’s accounting, information technology and human resources functions. Her work includes coordinating completion of its inaugural U.S. GAAP audit. She also leads the Company’s NetSuite implementation.

“Keirah has done excellent work advancing LibertyStream’s U.S. accounting and reporting capabilities, and we are grateful for her contributions,” Mr. Wylie added. “Her public-company accounting and SOX experience brings valuable depth to the team, and the Board has full confidence in her leadership of the finance function. These capabilities provide a strong operational foundation for LibertyStream.”
About LibertyStream Infrastructure Partners

LibertyStream is a lithium development and technology company aiming to be one of North America’s first commercial producers of lithium carbonate from oilfield brine. Our strategy is to generate value for shareholders by leveraging management’s hydrocarbon experience to deploy our proprietary DLE technology directly into existing oil and gas infrastructure, thereby reducing capital costs, lowering risks and supporting the world’s clean energy transition. We are committed to operating efficiently and with transparency across all areas of the business staying sharply focused on creating long-term, sustainable shareholder value.
